name: Plasma Mortar
desc: Lobbed plasma shell. Wind bends it.
svg: <path class="body" d="M5 23L9 17H18L22 13H36L42 17V27L37 30H23L19 27H17L15 36H10L11 27H5Z"/><path class="detail" d="M23 17V26M28 17V26M33 17V26M37 19V24M9 21H16"/><path class="light" d="M25 20H31M37 17V27"/>

name: Frag Charge
desc: Bounces around. Set the fuse from 1 to 5 seconds.
svg: <path class="body" d="M17 14H30L35 20V33L29 39H18L12 33V21Z M20 14V9H30V14"/><path class="detail" d="M13 25H34M14 31H34M21 16V37M27 16V37M29 9L34 5H39V10H34"/><path class="light" d="M17 20H29"/>

name: Rail Carbine
desc: Two dead-straight slugs with a small blast.
svg: <path class="body" d="M3 22L9 18H18L22 14H28V18H44V22H28L23 27H17L14 35H9L11 27H3Z"/><path class="detail" d="M26 16H43M27 25H43M19 19H24M7 21V25"/><path class="light" d="M29 20H43"/>

name: Scatter Gun
desc: Two blasts of buckshot. Nasty up close.

name: Dakka Bolter
desc: Fourteen-round burst with plenty of spray.
svg: <path class="body" d="M4 18H10L14 13H28V17H40L43 20V27H29L26 32H22V36H15L14 28H10L8 34H4L6 26H4Z"/><path class="detail" d="M14 17H26V26H14ZM18 29V33M23 29V33M33 20V25M38 20V25"/><path class="light" d="M17 21H23M30 17H39"/>

name: Las Burner
desc: A beam that burns straight through cover.

name: Promethium Flamer
desc: A wide hose of burning promethium. Washes over groups and sets the ground alight.

name: Chainblade
desc: Revs for 3s while you walk. Corner them. Last bite staggers.

name: Thunder Fist
desc: Light damage. An uppercut that launches them skyward.

name: Sun Grenade
desc: A small star. Same adjustable fuse.

name: Fusion Mine
desc: Drop it and run. Arms in 3s, then blows when anyone comes close.

name: Orbital Lance
desc: Pick a spot. The sky answers.

name: Doomsday Shell
desc: Ends arguments. Raises the sump and poisons the crater.
svg: <path class="body" d="M19 5H29L34 12V28L30 34L33 41L24 38L15 41L18 34L14 28V12Z"/><path class="detail" d="M15 14H33M18 31H30M24 33V38M19 10H29"/><path class="light" d="M20 20L24 17L28 20L26 25H22Z"/>

name: Minigun
desc: Seventy-five rounds that spray and riddle. Climbs a little, so keep it down.
svg: <path class="body" d="M4 17H16L19 13H26V18H42V29H26L22 33H18V38H12L11 29H4Z"/><path class="detail" d="M27 18V29M39 16V31M28 21H43M28 26H43M8 20H14V26H8ZM18 17V27"/><path class="light" d="M20 18V25M30 24H43"/>

name: Sentry Turret
desc: Overwatch. Each turn: one burst at the nearest enemy in sight, and one at anyone who walks into it.
svg: <path class="body" d="M10 12H29L33 17H42V23H28L24 27H20V31H29L37 42H31L24 35H17L10 42H4L12 31H17V26H10Z"/><path class="detail" d="M14 16H24V22H14ZM29 18V23M20 35V43"/><path class="light" d="M17 18H22M34 19H43"/>

name: Tracked Drone
desc: Rolls on its own for 8s. Steer it, jump to hop. Fire to detonate.
svg: <path class="body" d="M5 29L10 24H37L43 29V38H5Z M13 24V16H29L33 20V24"/><path class="detail" d="M8 31H40V35H8ZM14 31V35M22 31V35M30 31V35M20 19H26M31 16L36 9"/><path class="light" d="M17 22H25M36 9V5"/>

name: Godfall
desc: Climb in. A slow rocket launch at high angles, then a hard fall. Land on them.

name: Rappel Wire
desc: Walk off a ledge on a charged wire. Reel, swing, fire to release.

name: Jump Pack
desc: Hold fire to thrust. Does not end your turn.
svg: <path class="body" d="M9 9L14 5H21V32H9Z M27 5H34L39 9V32H27Z M21 13H27V24H21"/><path class="detail" d="M13 11H17V25H13ZM31 11H35V25H31ZM10 28H20M28 28H38"/><path class="light" d="M12 35L15 44L18 35M30 35L33 44L36 35"/>

name: Plasma Cutter
desc: Bores a tunnel in the aim direction. Burns anyone in front of the torch.

name: Fabricator
desc: Prints a girder anywhere within reach.
svg: <path class="body" d="M4 17H44V31H4Z M18 8H30V13H18Z"/><path class="detail" d="M5 28L12 20L20 28L27 20L35 28L42 20M4 20H44M4 28H44"/><path class="light" d="M24 3V7M24 34V44M20 39L24 43L28 39"/>

name: Teleporter
desc: Pick an open spot within range. Blink there.
